# trino_catalogs Data Source

Lists the catalogs registered with Trino.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "trino_catalogs" "example" {
  name_prefix = "hive"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) Only return catalogs whose name starts with this prefix.

### Read-Only

- `catalogs` (Attributes List) Catalogs exposed by the coordinator, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--catalogs))

<a id="nestedatt--catalogs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `catalogs`

Read-Only:

- `connector` (String) Connector backing the catalog.
- `name` (String) Catalog name.
